thread:
maria: Quick ask — can someone run the onboarding bench for axolotl-9b-v1 with the usual perf matrix? seq=1024, int8, batch sizes [1,4,8], and a short latency-focused sweep. Need p50/p95 and memory headroom.
aj: I can pick this up in ~30m. Which model variant should we prioritize — base or sparse-finetuned?
maria: Start with base. If base passes, then run the sparse-finetuned variant as a follow-up. Also include KV cache warmup=1 and inference warmup=20.
kai: noted. I'll spin a canary on dev-dedicated. Routing: use node pool d3-small for repeatability. Posting a run id when started.
perf-bot: run_started id=run_2026_axolotl_01 nodes=4 cfg={"seq":1024,"quant": "int8","batches": [1,4,8],"warmup":20} ETA ~18m
maria: thanks! please capture token-level breakdown for tok_rate and batching efficiency. Also record perf anomalies if p95 > 450ms.
sam: quick FYI — previous 9b models saw p95 ~380ms on this pool with int8. If we see 450+ it's likely a kernel fallback or memory thrash.
kai: run_2026_axolotl_01 finished. Attaching quick summary:
```
- batch=1: p50=68ms p95=145ms throughput=12 tok/s mem_gpu=22GB
- batch=4: p50=92ms p95=220ms throughput=44 tok/s mem_gpu=24GB
- batch=8: p50=140ms p95=480ms throughput=78 tok/s mem_gpu=28GB (p95 alarm)
notes: batch=8 sees p95 spike, trace shows occasional kernel fallback at decoder layer 10, scheduler jitter ~15ms
```
maria: ok looks like batch=8 is problematic for worst-case latency. Can you upload the perf trace and the nvprof output?
kai: uploaded to /s3/perf/axolotl/run_2026_axolotl_01/trace.json and nvprof.tar.gz. Link: https://s3.redwood.ai/axolotl/run_2026_axolotl_01
aj: I'll do a small repro with seq=512 and batch=8 to see if it's sequence-length dependent. Also will try q4_0 to compare.
perf-bot: followup_metrics id=run_2026_axolotl_01 p50_over_time=[70,88,120] p95_over_time=[150,210,480] cpu_noise=low gpu_saturation=0.78
sam: looks like decoder tiling heuristics may need adjustment. @maria any preference on next step — disable tiling for layer 10 in canary or try quant change?
maria: disable tiling for layer 10 in a canary; if that removes fallback then we tune heuristics. Also schedule a quick regression check against orion9b baseline to ensure no throughput regress.
kai: will run canary with tiling disabled for layer10 and post results. ETA 40m.
aj: queued a q4_0 sweep as well; will share numbers in this thread.
maria: great — thanks everyone. Action items: 1) kai: canary with tiling disabled (layer 10) 2) aj: q4_0 sweep + seq=512 repro 3) sam: review kernel fallback logs and propose heuristic delta. Please update this thread when done. :thumbsup:
